notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a black and/or red creature.
description:
Cast Honorable Scout by paying {W}.
When Honorable Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Honorable Scout
When Honorable Scout dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Honorable Scout from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
